title: EVIS EXERA Bronchoscopy — Visualization
exact_identifier_basis: The current Olympus America product page names both BF-H190 and BF-1TH190 exactly as bronchoscopes in the EVIS EXERA III portfolio.
factual_summary: Olympus America currently presents BF-H190 and BF-1TH190 as members of its U.S. bronchoscopy portfolio.
limitations: The page confirms model-level portfolio presence, not a purchasable configuration, inventory, or orderability on a particular date.

title: Tracheal/Bronchial Stents
exact_identifier_basis: The official product page contains an ordering table with exact ST02 catalog references and dimensions.
factual_summary: Micro-Tech's current global product page lists the tracheal/bronchial stent family and exact ST02 reference numbers.
limitations: This is not a U.S.-specific page. The current Micro-Tech Endoscopy USA catalog page does not expose this airway-stent family, so the source cannot establish current U.S. distribution.

title: ERBE Product Catalog — Instruments and Accessories
exact_identifier_basis: The catalog hosted by Erbe's U.S. site lists exact bipolar cable numbers in its connection and length tables.
factual_summary: The active Erbe U.S. catalog identifies exact connecting-cable references and their connector standards and lengths.
limitations: A broad catalog entry does not establish that every country-specific cable or adapter is currently stocked in the United States. Exact U.S. sales availability still requires confirmation.

title: ERBECRYO 2 with Flexible Single-Use Cryoprobes
exact_identifier_basis: The U.S. brochure's product-data table gives exact product numbers for the cryoprobes and ERBECRYO 2 accessories.
factual_summary: Erbe USA's June 2023 brochure identifies the ERBECRYO 2 system, three single-use cryoprobes, and related accessories by exact product number, establishing exact product identity and configuration as of that publication.
limitations: A dated brochure is a point-in-time publication, not a live catalog. It is retained as exact official identity/configuration evidence and is deliberately not admitted as current-distribution evidence: it does not state that any product is distributed today, and it states nothing about stock or orderability.

title: ERBE Product Catalog — Instruments and Accessories

factual_summary: The active catalog on Erbe's U.S. site identifies exact APC probe, applicator, and accessory references.
limitations: The catalog includes country-specific pressure reducers and connector standards. Hosting on the U.S. site is not sufficient by itself to classify every listed configuration as currently distributed in the United States.

title: Wayne Pneumothorax Catheter Set and Tray

factual_summary: Cook's current page states that products on the site are available for sale in the United States and lists G56532 and G56535 in the Wayne Pneumothorax line.
limitations: This page directly covers two products in SRC020; the other drainage-set catalog numbers need their corresponding Cook product pages. It does not establish inventory or immediate shipment.

factual_summary: Richard Wolf's VI25 thoracic endoscopy catalog identifies the current global catalog family and exact product numbers represented in SRC021.
limitations: The catalog explicitly warns that some products may not be available in all countries. It is not U.S.-specific and therefore cannot establish current U.S. distribution without a U.S. source or direct confirmation.

limitations: The page does not include the Cohen blocker order number G44122, so that product requires a separate current official page. Page presence does not establish inventory.

limitations: The source does not corroborate the exact identifiers imported from the 2011 SRC030 catalog. The page also instructs users to contact the local subsidiary for local approval and availability, so all exact-SKU U.S. statuses remain unresolved.
